notes: Partition verified: 32 source IDs and 42 target IDs each used once.
The ethical dative לְךָ is split — preposition `unrepresented` under rule 40, suffix to *thee* — unlike v.5, where the ASV writes nothing at all for either morpheme.
אוּלַי takes the whole *it may be* frame headed on *may* under rule 31; the competing head on *be* is named in the unit's note as rule 8 requires.
